When RPE is falling, two root causes explain most cases. Headcount grew faster than revenue, meaning the organization hired ahead of actual demand. Or revenue declined while headcount held steady, meaning a retention or hiring freeze decision is already overdue. Each cause calls for a different response.

Labor-intensive industries such as restaurants, general retail and hospitals cluster at the low end, with RPE figures below $35,000 in some cases, reflecting high headcount relative to revenue.
